Key.Original: Reads the papers again on the server (after a change made elsewhere).
Key.English: Reads the papers again on the server (after a change made elsewhere).
Key.French: Relit les papiers sur le serveur (après un changement fait ailleurs).

Key.Original: Reading the papers on the server…
Key.English: Reading the papers on the server…
Key.French: Lecture des papiers sur le serveur…

Key.Original: No answer from the server: press Refresh.
Key.English: No answer from the server: press Refresh.
Key.French: Pas de réponse du serveur : appuyez sur Actualiser.

Key.Original: This person or object no longer exists.
Key.English: This person or object no longer exists.
Key.French: Cette personne ou cet objet n'existe plus.

Key.Original: This AI has no papers: create some?
Key.English: This AI has no papers: create some?
Key.French: Cette IA n'a pas de papiers : en créer ?

Key.Original: This person has no papers: create some?
Key.English: This person has no papers: create some?
Key.French: Cette personne n'a pas de papiers : en créer ?

Key.Original: No identity paper in this object: place one here?
Key.English: No identity paper in this object: place one here?
Key.French: Aucun papier d'identité dans cet objet : en poser un ici ?

Key.Original: Paper of %1 found on this person.
Key.English: Paper of %1 found on this person.
Key.French: Papier de %1 trouvé sur cette personne.

Key.Original: Virtual paper: the inventory item appears when someone asks for it.
Key.English: Virtual paper: the inventory item appears when someone asks for it.
Key.French: Papier virtuel : l'objet apparaît dans l'inventaire quand on le lui demande.

Key.Original: Inventory item: the paper physically exists.
Key.English: Inventory item: the paper physically exists.
Key.French: Objet d'inventaire : le papier existe vraiment.
Numéro du document sur un BOLO (%1, %2).
Papier vrai à un autre nom

Key.Original: Genuine paper, but not in their name: they lie about who they are.
Key.English: Genuine paper, but not in their name: they lie about who they are.
Key.French: Papier vrai, mais pas à son nom : il ment sur son identité.

Key.Original: Prepared cover: everything passes except biometrics (N4).
Key.English: Prepared cover: everything passes except biometrics (N4).
Key.French: Couverture préparée : tout passe sauf la biométrie (N4).

Key.Original: Forged papers (%1, quality %2): %3 flaw(s) on the document.
Key.English: Forged papers (%1, quality %2): %3 flaw(s) on the document.
Key.French: Faux papiers (%1, qualité %2) : %3 défaut(s) sur le document.

Key.Original: Blank document: no holder, nothing printed.
Key.English: Blank document: no holder, nothing printed.
Key.French: Document vierge : aucun titulaire, rien d'imprimé.

Key.Original: %1/100: does not matter for genuine papers (only for a forgery).
Key.English: %1/100: does not matter for genuine papers (only for a forgery).
Key.French: %1/100 : ne compte pas pour de vrais papiers (seulement pour un faux).

Key.Original: %1/100: does not matter for a cover, the document is flawless.
Key.English: %1/100: does not matter for a cover, the document is flawless.
Key.French: %1/100 : ne compte pas pour une couverture, le document est parfait.

Key.Original: %1: on this forgery (%2 or more was needed to avoid it).
Key.English: %1: on this forgery (%2 or more was needed to avoid it).
Key.French: %1 : présent sur ce faux (il fallait %2 ou plus pour l'éviter).

Key.Original: By eye (N0), flaws show more when quality is low: factor %1 (1.25 for a crude fake, 0.25 for a perfect one).
Key.English: By eye (N0), flaws show more when quality is low: factor %1 (1.25 for a crude fake, 0.25 for a perfect one).
Key.French: À l'œil (N0), les défauts se voient d'autant plus que la qualité est basse : facteur %1 (1,25 pour un faux grossier, 0,25 pour un faux parfait).

Key.Original: Unknown process: no flaw drawn from the quality.
Key.English: Unknown process: no flaw drawn from the quality.
Key.French: Procédé inconnu : aucun défaut tiré de la qualité.

Key.Original: the security hologram is not there; seen by eye (N0), better in daylight or with a torch.
Key.English: the security hologram is not there; seen by eye (N0), better in daylight or with a torch.
Key.French: le motif holographique de sécurité manque ; visible à l'œil (N0), mieux de jour ou à la lampe.

Key.Original: the name is not printed with the same characters as the rest: printed or retouched separately (N0).
Key.English: the name is not printed with the same characters as the rest: printed or retouched separately (N0).
Key.French: le nom n'est pas imprimé avec les mêmes caractères que le reste : imprimé ou retouché à part (N0).

Key.Original: a check digit of the MRZ strip is wrong: the scanner (N1) always sees it.
Key.English: a check digit of the MRZ strip is wrong: the scanner (N1) always sees it.
Key.French: un chiffre de contrôle de la bande MRZ est faux : le scanner (N1) le voit à coup sûr.

Key.Original: the MRZ strip still carries the old name: the front was retouched (N1).
Key.English: the MRZ strip still carries the old name: the front was retouched (N1).
Key.French: la bande MRZ garde l'ancien nom : le recto a été retouché (N1).

Key.Original: the photo was peeled off and replaced: lifted edge, redone lamination (N0).
Key.English: the photo was peeled off and replaced: lifted edge, redone lamination (N0).
Key.French: la photo a été décollée et remplacée : bord relevé, plastification reprise (N0).

Key.Original: flaw added by a mission or an extension.
Key.English: flaw added by a mission or an extension.
Key.French: défaut ajouté par une mission ou une extension.
N0 à l'œil : rien de visible.

Key.Original: N0 by eye: %1 (depends on light and on the checker).
Key.English: N0 by eye: %1 (depends on light and on the checker).
Key.French: N0 à l'œil : %1 (selon la lumière et le contrôleur).

Key.Original: Expired since %1: doubt at every level.
Key.English: Expired since %1: doubt at every level.
Key.French: Périmé depuis le %1 : doute à chaque niveau.

Key.Original: N1 MRZ: no MRZ strip on this document.
Key.English: N1 MRZ: no MRZ strip on this document.
Key.French: N1 MRZ : pas de bande MRZ sur ce document.
N1 MRZ : chiffre de contrôle faux (faux).

Key.Original: N1 MRZ: name different from the front (forgery).
Key.English: N1 MRZ: name different from the front (forgery).
Key.French: N1 MRZ : nom différent du recto (faux).

Key.Original: N2 chip: this document has none.
Key.English: N2 chip: this document has none.
Key.French: N2 puce : ce document n'en a pas.

Key.Original: N2 chip: missing on a document that needs one (doubt).
Key.English: N2 chip: missing on a document that needs one (doubt).
Key.French: N2 puce : absente alors qu'il en faut une (doute).

Key.Original: N2 chip: data different from the document (forgery).
Key.English: N2 chip: data different from the document (forgery).
Key.French: N2 puce : données différentes du document (faux).

Key.Original: N2 chip: the stored photo is not the printed one (forgery).
Key.English: N2 chip: the stored photo is not the printed one (forgery).
Key.French: N2 puce : la photo enregistrée n'est pas celle imprimée (faux).

Key.Original: N3 database: issued in this name.
Key.English: N3 database: issued in this name.
Key.French: N3 base : délivré à ce nom.

Key.Original: N4 face: this is not %1 (true identity: %2).
Key.English: N4 face: this is not %1 (true identity: %2).
Key.French: N4 visage : ce n'est pas %1 (vraie identité : %2).

Key.Original: Opens the Choose a document window for this person (or this place).
Key.English: Opens the Choose a document window for this person (or this place).
Key.French: Ouvre la fenêtre Choisir un document pour cette personne (ou cet endroit).

Key.Original: Opens the Choose a document window: type, country, nature, forgery quality, printed name.
Key.English: Opens the Choose a document window: type, country, nature, forgery quality, printed name.
Key.French: Ouvre la fenêtre Choisir un document : type, pays, nature, qualité du faux, nom imprimé.

Key.Original: Remakes this paper as genuine, same name.
Key.English: Remakes this paper as genuine, same name.
Key.French: Refait ce papier en vrai, même nom.

Key.Original: Remakes this paper as a forgery (quality 50), same name: flaws drawn from the quality.
Key.English: Remakes this paper as a forgery (quality 50), same name: flaws drawn from the quality.
Key.French: Refait ce papier en faux (qualité 50), même nom : défauts tirés selon la qualité.

Key.Original: All papers of this person reported stolen: seen at the N3 check.
Key.English: All papers of this person reported stolen: seen at the N3 check.
Key.French: Tous les papiers de la personne signalés volés : vu au contrôle N3.

Key.Original: Lifts the stolen / lost / revoked report on all papers of this person.
Key.English: Lifts the stolen / lost / revoked report on all papers of this person.
Key.French: Lève le signalement (volé, perdu, révoqué) de tous les papiers de la personne.

Key.Original: This AI no longer carries any paper.
Key.English: This AI no longer carries any paper.
Key.French: Cette IA ne porte plus aucun papier.

Key.Original: Opens the Area AI page of the SSE editor on this AI.
Key.English: Opens the Area AI page of the SSE editor on this AI.
Key.French: Ouvre la page IA de la zone de l'éditeur SSE sur cette IA.

Key.Original: Choose the document in the other window; this one reads again after.
Key.English: Choose the document in the other window; this one reads again after.
Key.French: Choisissez le document dans l'autre fenêtre ; celle-ci se relit ensuite.

Key.Original: The cover marked "Active on Athena" is the one you chose on the site: once imported, it becomes your active cover and replaces the previous one. The others stay on this computer, ready to activate here.
Key.English: The cover marked "Active on Athena" is the one you chose on the site: once imported, it becomes your active cover and replaces the previous one. The others stay on this computer, ready to activate here.
Key.French: La couverture marquée « Active sur Athena » est celle que vous avez choisie sur le site : importée, elle devient votre couverture active et remplace celle d'avant. Les autres restent sur ce poste, prêtes à activer ici.

Key.Original: Your current cover is no longer on Athena (revoked or removed). It stays active on this computer until you pick another one.
Key.English: Your current cover is no longer on Athena (revoked or removed). It stays active on this computer until you pick another one.
Key.French: Votre couverture en cours n'est plus sur Athena (révoquée ou retirée). Elle reste active sur ce poste tant que vous n'en choisissez pas une autre.
